name: @tangen/realtime
description: The Tangen realtime client - lazy, one multiplexed connection per tab, WebSocket with automatic SSE fallback, reconnect with cursor resume. Framework-neutral; depends on @tangen/sdk for auth and base URL only.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json
